0: 511-6-1.04(6)(f) -  time/temperature control for safety; hot holding  (p)

Inspector Notes: Observed 2 pans of aloo tikki hot holding below 135F in warmer cabinet. COS: PIC placed pans in oven to reheat. CA: Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control, time/temperature control for safety food shall be maintained at 41°F (5°C) or below or 135°F (57°C) or above.
1: Inspector Notes: Observed several employees working with unpackaged foods with wrist jewelry on. COS: Watches removed but reminded PIC that woven/permanent bracelets shall be removed too.
